caption: The drawing depicts a wooden stool or ottoman with a padded, dark gray top adorned with a small, colorful, floral embroidery consisting of red, green, and purple elements placed at the center. The body of the stool is constructed from wood illustrated with a reddish-brown tone showing wood grain, and it features decorative carved patterns along the base with four sturdy feet. The whole stool is centered within a lightly outlined rectangular frame. In the bottom left corner of the drawing is a separate, partially outlined square containing a pencil sketch of a circular floral wreath, showing loosely drawn flowers and leaves, corresponding to the embroidered design on the stool's cushion. The paper background is off-white or beige, and the artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner inside the frame.
title: Ottoman
